# Kamruzzaman Polash

> Backend software engineer (Laravel, PHP, MySQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes) based in Mymensingh, Bangladesh. Builds multi-tenant SaaS, e-commerce and POS platforms, courier and payment integrations (Pathao, Steadfast, RedX, CarryBee, bKash, SSLCommerz), and Laravel REST APIs. Available for remote full-time roles, team collaboration and client projects worldwide.

- [Services](https://polash.link/services/): SaaS architecture, commerce and courier integrations, performance, queues, Docker/Kubernetes and AI pipelines.
- [Engineering blog](https://polash.link/blog/): production-focused Laravel articles (queues, MySQL optimisation, REST APIs, Docker/Kubernetes, AI integration).

## Notable work
- [Vendzoo](https://vendzoo.com): own multi-tenant retail and commerce SaaS (POS, Shopify and WooCommerce sync, multi-courier dispatch, COD fraud scoring, double-entry accounting). Live and onboarding early users.
- [pola5h/laravel-flags](https://github.com/pola5h/laravel-flags): open-source Laravel package with 249 country and 210 language flags as Blade components.
